sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the floors of an ancient high-tech shrine built by a vanished civilisation: large machined plates of pale grey and lavender-grey composite cut in concentric rings round a central disc and divided by radial joints, plates of slightly different tones, fine engraved border lines a hand in from each joint, thin inlaid lines of soft light along some rings, a few small round sockets and a recessed service hatch, very fine machining marks, a faint worn sheen where feet pass. Clean, precise, futuristic, timeless. Three panels side by side: a large swatch seen from straight above; the same floor of a round hall seen from a walker's height with a small figure for scale; a strip showing the detail simplifying with distance, rings and light lines staying, fine marks gone far. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, pale grey, lavender-grey, slate, a single peach or cyan light accent, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, moss, vines, roots, organic, rot, ruins.
